title: Reconcile tenant metrics window misalignment and rebuild dashboards after ingestion gap
creator: Evan Torres
description:
Summary: Multiple customers reported missing time-series on Console dashboards and sparse traces during a cluster incident affecting Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Symptoms included blank panel tiles, N/A metric series for tenant-scoped dashboards, and trace spans with missing parent-child links for requests routed during the incident window.

Scope: Affected components: metrics ingestion pipeline (kafka -> ingestion service), time-window compaction job, and Console live-query cache layer. Customers reported missing data for the window 2026-02-28T21:00Z -> 2026-02-28T23:30Z across several tenants with varying deployment modes.

Initial hypothesis: Ingestion watermark handling change (rolled out in ENG-39902) advanced the partition watermark during partial outage, which combined with an aggressive TTL compaction in the time-window job caused tombstoning of partially-ingested series. Console's live-query fallback incorrectly cached empty results for tenant-level queries, leading to persistent blank panels even after backfill finished.

Impact: High — multiple paying customers escalated to support with service-impacting dashboards and inability to correlate incidents. SLA and troubleshooting were affected for Dedicated customers with committed SLOs and Private customers on air-gapped upgrades.

Goal: Restore missing metrics for affected tenants, patch ingestion and Console to prevent recurrence, add monitoring/alerting for similar watermark-compaction races, and document runbook for this class of incident.
comments: 2026-03-01: Incident detected by on-call after multiple customer escalations. Triage team formed (Observability + Ingestion). Initial mitigation: turned off TTL compaction for affected time-shards and triggered a controlled reingest for 2.5h window.

2026-03-02: Reingest job (backfill-tenant-window) started; early signals show series reappearing for ~60% of tenants. Noted persistent blank tiles for some tenant dashboards even after metrics returned — likely Console caching issue.

2026-03-03: Repro steps documented in repo and Confluence. Root cause narrowed to watermark fast-forward bug introduced in ENG-39902 plus a race between compaction and partial-write tombstone cleanup. Console caching logic (live-query result cache key) used a tenant->time-range hash that could collide with an 'empty result' sentinel; cache was not invalidated on reingest.

2026-03-04: Hotfixes: 1) ingestion: stop fast-forwarding partition watermark when broker ack is partial (PR #1248). 2) console: add cache-invalidator hook on backfill completion and change sentinel handling (PR #1251). Deployed to staging 2026-03-05.

2026-03-06: Staging verification: synthetic client replay shows metrics persist and dashboards hydrate correctly. Canary deploy to one Hosted cluster and two Dedicated customers scheduled for 2026-03-07 AM UTC.

2026-03-07: Canary passed. Rolling patch rollout started for Hosted and Dedicated; Private package uploaded for customers doing manual upgrade. Support notified with per-tenant remediation commands to force dashboard refresh where needed.

2026-03-09: Post-deploy monitoring: reingest job finished for remaining tenants. Support confirmed recovery for most escalated customers. Two Private customers needed a manual metrics reindex due to air-gap constraints — operations assisted.
2026-03-11: Incident review prep: draft postmortem created and linked below. Action items assigned for additional tests and alerting.
2026-03-12: This ticket tracks the remaining follow-ups and verification items before marking Done. Current owner: Maya Jensen.
postmortem_summary: (WIP) Root cause: watermark fast-forward + compaction race produced tombstoned partial series. Secondary cause: Console cache treating empty result sentinel as authoritative. Corrective actions: hotfix ingestion watermark handling, cache invalidation on backfills, deploy backfill tooling, add integration tests, and alert for unexpected shard compaction events.
next_steps: 1) Merge follow-up test coverage PR and block merge until CI includes a simulated partition-loss scenario. 2) Add Prometheus alert 'ingestion_compaction_risk' when compaction jobs run while partition ack lag > 5m. 3) Update runbook with explicit backfill commands and Console cache invalidation steps. 4) Schedule postmortem review with affected customers (by 2026-03-18).
verification_steps: 1) Confirm Grafana panels show non-empty series for impacted tenants across last-14d. 2) Run synthetic end-to-end replay for partition edge case and ensure no tombstones present. 3) Validate Console cache invalidation behaves correctly after simulated backfill. 4) Monitor alert rate for 72 hours after rollout.
notes_for_support: Use 'backfill-tenant-window --tenant <tenant> --from <start> --to <end>' to trigger controlled reingest. After backfill completes, run 'console cache:invalidate --tenant <tenant> --range <start>-<end>' if panels remain blank. Escalate to on-call observability if reingest fails with 'partition missing' errors.
customer_communication: Support: sent status updates 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-09. Planned: postmortem and remediation summary going to affected accounts by 2026-03-18.
owner_handovers: If Maya is unavailable, handover to Evan Torres with link to PRs and backfill automation script in the links above.
arch_notes: Consider moving to two-phase compaction: mark then remove with quiesce window and explicit checkpointing to avoid racing with partial writes. Also evaluate per-tenant compaction isolation for Dedicated/Private customers with strict SLOs.
